{{Top|leg}}
'''Loeerna''' was the [[Teltior]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] owner of the [[Happy Spacer]] retail business on the [[Vergesso Base]] [[Asteroid Hangar|asteroid hangar]].

Loeerna sold intoxicants and [[Spice/Legends|spiced]] [[alcohol/Legends|drinks]] and would send customers to [[D'ring'my]] for more. She had seen enough of the use of her merchandise to avoid it herself, but was not interested in the moral implications and went on her business.
